name: Ebony Horse
oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Untap target attacking creature you control. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: {2}, {T}: Untap target attacking creature you control. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (a field on the permanent shield read by the damage primitives), so a resolving activated ability can install a this-turn shield that stops only COMBAT damage dealt to and dealt by one targeted permanent
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `untap` on a target with selector {controller: you, attacking: true} covers the first sentence, and `prevent_damage_permanent` with dealt: to_and_by and duration: this_turn is the right shape but stops ALL damage (op_options are only dealt, duration, objects), so noncombat damage to or by the creature would also be prevented; `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` static, which is continuous on a printed permanent, only faces 'to', and cannot be installed on a target for a turn by an activated ability
